### Active Lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`)
- `L-001`: Remove any untracked `._*` files under `app/` if present.
- `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL integration test `IamUserDirectoryOnboardingExportsTest.java` (`*Test.java`).
- `L-003`: Cross-context ports (`com.example.app.iam.port.IamRoleGrantPort`, `com.example.app.iam.port.DirectoryLookupPort`, and `com.example.app.governance.port.GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort`) must use value records in `.port` packages and never leak `.domain` or `.repository` classes across bounded contexts (`LayerRulesTest`).
- `L-004`: Annotate refusal-auditing service methods (`IAM_SELF_LOCKOUT_REFUSED`, `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`) with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors. Also check `app/backend/spotbugs-exclude.xml` to see how SpotBugs `EI_EXPOSE_REP`/`EI_EXPOSE_REP2` is configured or suppressed for Spring beans if needed.

### Step-by-Step Instructions
1. **Red TDD Step (`Attempt 1`):**
   - Create any minimal port/DTO types needed so `app/backend/src/test/java/com/example/app/iam/IamUserDirectoryOnboardingExportsTest.java` compiles (`IamRoleGrantPort`, `IamRoleGrantRequest`, `IamRoleGrantResult`, `DirectoryLookupPort`, `DirectoryUserProfile`, `DirectorySearchPage`), and write `IamUserDirectoryOnboardingExportsTest.java` with the 8 `@Test` methods matching `docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/plan.md`:
     - `ac1_listAndFilterPortalUserAccountsWithOffsetPagination`
     - `ac2_inspectAndUpdateUserStatusOrDepartmentWithSessionRevocationOnDeactivation`
     - `ac3_assignOrRevokeUserRolesWithOptionalExpiryAndExposeIamRoleGrantPort`
     - `ac4_searchCorporateWorkspaceDirectoryProfilesViaDeterministicMockAdapter`
     - `ac5_submitSelfServiceRoleApplyOnboardingOrAccessExpansionGovernanceTicket`
     - `ac6_streamCsvAccessReviewExportsWithFormulaSanitizationAndExcludeExpiredRoleAssignments`
     - `ac7_refuseAdminSelfLockoutUnauthorizedCallersAndViewAsMutations`
     - `ac8_refuseSodConflictsUnknownUserIdsConcurrencyDuplicateTicketsInvalidInputsAndDirectoryOutages`
   - Run `sh .agents-v0/scripts/check-attempt-budget.sh docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/build-report.md` and then run `cd app/backend && ./mvnw -B clean verify -P!ci-security` so the new test fails RED (because the `/api/v1/iam/users`, `/api/v1/iam/directory`, `/api/v1/iam/role-applications`, `/api/v1/iam/exports/**` endpoints are not yet implemented).
   - Record Attempt 1 (`Exit: 1`) in `docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/build-report.md`.

2. **Green Implementation (`AC-1`..`AC-8` per `docs/agents-v0/design/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/design.md` & `ADR 0009`):**
   - **`ContractProblemException`**:
     - Add `selfLockoutPrevented(String detail)` -> `HttpStatus.CONFLICT`, `ContractErrorCode.SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED`, `"Self-Lockout Prevented"`.
     - Add `idempotencyKeyReplayConflict(String detail)` -> `HttpStatus.CONFLICT`, `ContractErrorCode.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_CONFLICT`, `"Conflict"`.
     - Add `directoryUnavailable(String detail)` -> `HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `ContractErrorCode.DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE`, `"Service Unavailable"`.
   - **Baseline Route Permissions (`ViewAsOverlayService` & `RbacManagementService`)**:
     - Add to `ViewAsOverlayService.ADMIN_BASELINE_PERMISSIONS`:
       - `("iam:users:read", "GET", "/api/v1/iam/users")`
       - `("iam:users:inspect", "GET", "/api/v1/iam/users/{id}")`
       - `("iam:users:write", "PATCH", "/api/v1/iam/users/{id}")`
       - `("iam:user-roles:write", "PUT", "/api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles")`
       - `("iam:directory:read", "GET", "/api/v1/iam/directory")`
       - `("iam:role-applications:write", "POST", "/api/v1/iam/role-applications")`
       - `("iam:exports:users", "GET", "/api/v1/iam/exports/users")`
       - `("iam:exports:roles", "GET", "/api/v1/iam/exports/roles")`
     - In `RbacManagementService.hasPermission(...)`, normalize aliases so holding `iam:users:read` or `IAM_USERS_READ` satisfies `iam:users:read` and `iam:users:inspect`; `IAM_USERS_WRITE` satisfies `iam:users:write`; `IAM_USER_ROLES_WRITE` satisfies `iam:user-roles:write`; `IAM_DIRECTORY_READ` satisfies `iam:directory:read`; `iam:exports:read` or `IAM_EXPORTS_READ` satisfies `iam:exports:users` and `iam:exports:roles`.
     - In `RbacManagementService.evaluateRoute(...)`:
       - When `method` is `"POST"` and `requestUri` is `"/api/v1/iam/role-applications"` (and `!readOnlyOverlay`), allow any authenticated caller (`RouteAuthorizationDecision(true, "iam:role-applications:write", null, null)`), so zero-role newly onboarded operators (`redirectView = "ROLE_APPLY_ONBOARDING"`) and existing operators can submit self-service role applications (`AC-5`), while `readOnlyOverlay == true` is still rejected at the top of `evaluateRoute` with `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` (`AC-7`).
   - **Session Revocation on User Deactivation (`SessionStorePort`, `RedisSessionStoreAdapter`, `FailClosedRedisSessionFilter`, `BffAuthService`)**:
     - Add `void revokeAllSessionsForUser(UUID userId, Duration blacklistTtl)` and `boolean isUserRevoked(UUID userId)` (or clear user revocation on `storeSession`) to `SessionStorePort` and `RedisSessionStoreAdapter`:
       - When `storeSession(claims, ttl)` runs, also maintain a comma-separated session list under `portal:user-sessions:<userId>` and delete `portal:user-revoked:<userId>`.
       - When `revokeAllSessionsForUser(userId, ttl)` runs, read `portal:user-sessions:<userId>`, revoke each session ID (`portal:session:<sid>` deleted + `portal:blacklist:<sid>` set), delete `portal:user-sessions:<userId>`, and set `portal:user-revoked:<userId> = "revoked"` with `ttl`.
       - When `updateStatusAndDepartment` re-activates a user (`isActive = true`), clear `portal:user-revoked:<userId>` (e.g., via `sessionStorePort.clearUserRevocation(userId)`).
       - In `FailClosedRedisSessionFilter.verifyAndResolvePrincipal`, check `!user.isActive()` (already present!) and `sessionStorePort.isTokenRevoked(sessionId)`.
   - **Repositories (`UserRepository`, `UserRoleAssignmentRepository`, `GovernanceTicketRepository`)**:
     - `UserRepository`: add `countFiltered(String search)`, `findAllFiltered(String search, int offset, int limit)`, `findAllOrdered()`, and `updateStatusAndDepartment(UUID id, boolean isActive, String department, Instant updatedAt)`. Use case-insensitive substring matching (`LOWER(workspace_email) LIKE ? OR LOWER(display_name) LIKE ? OR LOWER( COALESCE(department, '') ) LIKE ?`) ordered by `created_at ASC, workspace_email ASC`.
     - `UserRoleAssignmentRepository`: add `findAllByUserId(UUID userId)` and `revokeActiveAssignmentsByUserId(UUID userId, Instant revokedAt)`.
     - `GovernanceTicketRepository`: add `findByIdempotencyKey(String idempotencyKey)` and `findOpenRoleApplicationsByRequester(UUID requesterUserId)`.
   - **Cross-Context Governance Ticket Port (`com.example.app.governance.port` & `com.example.app.governance.service`)**:
     - `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort`, `RoleApplicationTicketCreateCommand`, `SubmittedGovernanceTicketView` in `com.example.app.governance.port`.
     - `GovernanceTicketSubmissionService` in `com.example.app.governance.service` implementing `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort`: checks for duplicate open `PENDING_APPROVAL` `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` tickets for `requesterUserId` with overlapping role IDs (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`), generates a deterministic unique `ticket_number` (`"TKT-IAM-" + ...`), inserts into `GovernanceTicketRepository` (`status = "PENDING_APPROVAL"`, `ticketType = "IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION"`, `version = 0`), and returns `SubmittedGovernanceTicketView`.
   - **Corporate Directory Port & Adapter (`com.example.app.iam.port` & `com.example.app.iam.adapter`)**:
     - `DirectoryLookupPort`, `DirectoryUserProfile`, `DirectorySearchPage` in `com.example.app.iam.port`.
     - `CorporateDirectoryLookupAdapter` in `com.example.app.iam.adapter` with deterministic seeded corporate directory profiles (e.g. Ana Santos `ana.santos@gcash.com` in Finance, Carlos Reyes `carlos.reyes@gcash.com` in Treasury, Elena Cruz `elena.cruz@gcash.com` in Accounting, Marco Lim `marco.lim@gcash.com` in Risk, plus any users in `UserRepository`) and a `setSimulatedOutage(boolean)` + circuit-breaker failure counter so tests can verify `503 DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE` fail-closed behavior (`AC-4`, `AC-8`).
   - **IAM User Access & Export Services (`UserAccessService`, `CsvFormulaSanitizer`, DTOs, `IamAdminController`)**:
     - DTOs in `com.example.app.iam.api.dto`: `UserRoleAssignmentDto`, `UserDto`, `UserResponse`, `UserListResponse`, `UserStatusUpdateRequest`, `UserRoleAssignmentItemRequest`, `UserRoleAssignmentsUpdateRequest`, `DirectoryUserDto`, `DirectoryUserListResponse`, `RoleApplicationCreateRequest`, `GovernanceTicketDto`, `GovernanceTicketResponse`. Ensure `@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = false)` on all write request DTOs and `List.copyOf` / `Map.copyOf` in compact constructors.
     - `CsvFormulaSanitizer` in `com.example.app.iam.service`: prefixes any cell value starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, or `\r` with `'`, and applies RFC 4180 quoting (`"..."` with `""` escaping) when commas, quotes, or newlines are present.
     - `UserAccessService` implementing `IamRoleGrantPort` (and split helper support if needed to keep classes and methods concise and <= 30 lines per method!).
     - Wire all 8 endpoints on `IamAdminController` (or a dedicated `@RestController` under `com.example.app.iam.api` such as `IamUserDirectoryController` if `IamAdminController` would get too large—note `design.md` mentions `IamAdminController`, so keeping the methods on `IamAdminController` or delegating cleanly from `IamAdminController` is great!).

3. **Verify & Evidence**:
   - Run `sh .agents-v0/scripts/check-attempt-budget.sh docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/build-report.md` before each verify run.
   - Run `cd app/backend && ./mvnw -B clean verify -P!ci-security` to confirm green fast verify, update `docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/plan.md` rows to `done`, and then run `cd app/backend && ./mvnw -B clean verify -Pci-security` saving output to `docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/build-output.txt` and updating `docs/agents-v0/build/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports/build-report.md`.
